title: CREATURES
blurb: The five animals that earned a radical of their own.

radicals.name: HORSE
radicals.origin: A horse seen from the side. The old form had an eye, a mane and four legs. The simplified one keeps the outline and a single line for the legs.
ex: on a horse then, on a bicycle now
at first: to harness a horse to a cart
as in 骆驼, a horse-like animal with a hump
radicals.watch: 马 is also the sound part of some of the first characters you learn: 妈 (mom) and 吗 (the question word). There it sits on the right and lends its sound. As the radical it sits on the left or underneath and gives the meaning.

radicals.name: COW
radicals.origin: 牛 is the head of an ox seen from the front, with its horns on top. On the left of a character it leans over and its last stroke lifts.
ex: a hand with a stick drives the cattle
cattle were once the most valuable things a family owned
at first a bull, the one that stood out from the herd
an ox 牛 kept under a roof 宀
radicals.watch: Look-alike: 扌 (hand) has no tick at the top left. 牜 has one: the ox's horn. 告 (to tell) and 件 (item) contain 牛 but are filed under mouth and person.

radicals.name: SHEEP
radicals.origin: A sheep's head seen from the front: two horns on top and the face below. On top of a character its tail is cut short.
radicals.clue: sheep, and things once thought good
ex: a big 大 sheep was a fine sight
at first: to offer up a lamb
mouth watering over someone else's roast lamb
radicals.watch: The sheep hint is often an old-fashioned one: a fat sheep meant good things. 羊 also lends its sound, yáng, to 洋 (ocean), 样 (kind, way) and 养 (to raise). In those it is not the radical.

radicals.name: BIRD
radicals.origin: A bird in profile. The dot is its eye. Take the dot away and you get 乌, a crow: so black that its eye does not show.
ex: its sound part 我 is read wǒ
the bird underneath, the sound part on top
radicals.watch: Look-alike: 马 (horse) has an open top and no dot. 岛 (island) has a bird sitting on it but is filed under mountain.

radicals.name: FISH
radicals.origin: A fish standing on its tail: the head on top, the scaly body in the middle, and a flat line where the tail fins used to be.
radicals.clue: fish and creatures of the water
ex: fish 鱼 and lamb 羊, both best eaten fresh
not a fish, but it lives like one
radicals.watch: The fish family takes in water creatures that are not fish at all: whales, crocodiles, squid. 渔 (to go fishing) puts water in front of 鱼 and is filed under water.
